item.title: Port St. Lucie advances land transfer for new Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road
item.description: The Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance last month to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange coming to the Turnpike.

item.title: North Palm Beach hosts Fourth of July fireworks and pool party at country club
item.description: North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse will host Independence Day celebrations on July 4 with a pool party, barbecue buffet and fireworks at 9 p.m.

item.title: Four Martin County teens arrested after 14-year-old robbed at gunpoint
item.description: Martin County deputies arrested four teenagers after a 14-year-old boy was robbed at gunpoint. The teens led deputies on a chase following the alleged robbery.

item.title: Two rescued after boat sinks in Indian River Lagoon
item.description: Two boaters were rescued after their vessel sank in the Indian River Lagoon on Wednesday.
